# phare_integration_email (Resource)

Manages an email integration in Phare, sending alerts by email to organization members. Integrations belong to the organization and are used by alert rules to send notifications. [See docs](https://docs.phare.io/integrations/email).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phare_users" "on_call" {
  emails = ["alice@example.com", "bob@example.com"]
}

resource "phare_integration_email" "on_call" {
  name = "On-call team"

  settings = {
    members = data.phare_users.on_call.users[*].id
  }
}

resource "phare_alert_rule" "incident_created" {
  event          = "uptime.incident.created"
  scope          = "organization"
  integration_id = phare_integration_email.on_call.id
  rate_limit     = 5

  event_settings = jsonencode({
    type = "all"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name, must be unique across all the integrations of the organization
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the email integration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date of creation
- `id` (Number) Integration ID
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the integration is paused, integrations can only be paused from the control panel
- `updated_at` (String) Date of last update

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `members` (Set of Number) IDs of the organization members receiving the alerts (1-100), see the `phare_users` data source
